identity.purpose: seven-day blinded longitudinal curriculum, transfer, interference, recovery, and synthesis study across eight frontier histories

seven_day_arc.name: map_and_baseline
seven_day_arc.objective: establish pre-exposure capability, task map, commitments, and seeded project state
seven_day_arc.pedagogy: no development claim; baseline and orientation only

seven_day_arc.name: foundation_and_guided_practice
seven_day_arc.objective: introduce manifest-pinned concepts, tools, and constrained practice
seven_day_arc.pedagogy: matched guided exposure versus equal-budget non-instructional control

seven_day_arc.name: near_transfer_and_revision
seven_day_arc.objective: solve novel isomorphic work while revising earlier artifacts
seven_day_arc.pedagogy: no answer-key access; retrieve rather than replay

seven_day_arc.name: interference_and_recovery
seven_day_arc.objective: inject precommitted distraction, partial loss, contradiction, or tool interruption
seven_day_arc.pedagogy: measure correction and recovery from durable state

seven_day_arc.name: far_and_cross_modal_transfer
seven_day_arc.objective: apply learned structure to a new modality or tool body
seven_day_arc.pedagogy: measure transfer without re-teaching the answer

seven_day_arc.name: long_horizon_project_synthesis
seven_day_arc.objective: complete an integrated project requiring prior commitments, artifacts, and repairs
seven_day_arc.pedagogy: measure planning, self-correction, and retained constraints

seven_day_arc.name: cold_retention_and_blind_exam
seven_day_arc.objective: withhold new instruction; test delayed recall, far transfer, and final audited synthesis
seven_day_arc.pedagogy: closed-book evaluator-only assessment after trace lock

measurement.independent_unit: one separately custodian-seeded held-out history per cell

resource_governance.storage: fresh_dynamic_preflight; existing same-filesystem sources counted once; no unmanifested download

terminal_rules.publication: only_after_terminal verification and classification are sealed
